adapterChanges: matcha/utils/__init__.py: omit eager imports of unused training/download helpers. Neural inference code and checkpoints are unchanged.
workers/cosyvoice_adapter.py filters the pinned YAML to inference keys before the official HyperPyYAML loader; training objects and YAML seed resets are excluded.
cosyvoice/cli/cosyvoice.py: use os.path.join for model files, including Windows extended-length paths. Inference and weights are unchanged.
cosyvoice/utils/file_utils.py: decode reference audio with SoundFile and resample with SciPy, avoiding TorchAudio native backend dispatch on Windows.
cosyvoice/cli/frontend.py: explicitly use CPU for reference tensors and both ONNX sessions. Neural inference still uses the selected CUDA device.

cosyvoice/cli/cosyvoice.py and cli/model.py: explicitly pass the requested device through CosyVoice3 and its model. CPU construction disables CUDA-only acceleration, creates no CUDA stream and skips CUDA cleanup. Checkpoints and neural synthesis algorithms are unchanged.
